newsitem.title: UK: Sungei Way sets $100 mln convertible bond.
newsitem.headline: Sungei Way sets $100 mln convertible bond.

text.p: Sungei Way Holdings has issued a $100 million bond issue convertible into shares, joint lead managers Flemings and Merrill Lynch said. There is also a $10 million managers option.
Convertible into shares of Sungei Way Holdings, the conversion price is 16.20 Malaysian ringgits, a 12.65 percent premium over the five-day average closing share price of 14.38 ringgits.
Fixed forex rate of 2.524 ringgits. There are 155.80 shares per $1,000.

Final redemption will be at 130.17 to yield approximately 6.54 percent, which represents 50 basis points over five-year U.S. Treasury notes. Hard non call for three years, thereafter callable subject to 135 percent hurdle.
